# Research and stats

`game.research` lists projects, sets progress and finishes them. `game.stats` reads any stat of a thing with the game's own explanation of where the value comes from. Both are Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md).

```lua
-- Finish everything that is available and cheap
for _, r in ipairs(game.research.list("available")) do
  if r.cost < 500 then game.research.finish(r.def) end
end

-- Why is this colonist so slow?
print(game.stats.explain(colonist, "MoveSpeed").text)
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.stats.modify` | `stat, fn, opts?` | `integer` | Changes a stat wherever it is read. fn returns the new value. It runs on every read of the stat, so keep it small. Returns a modifier id. |
| `game.stats.add_offset` | `stat, value, opts?` | `integer` | Adds a fixed amount to a stat. |
| `game.stats.add_factor` | `stat, value, opts?` | `integer` | Multiplies a stat. |
| `game.stats.remove_modifier` | `id` | `boolean` | Removes a modifier. |
| `game.stats.modifiers` |  | `RimStatModifierInfo[]` | Active modifiers. |
| `game.research.list` | `filter?` | `RimResearchInfo[]` | All projects, or only finished, available or locked ones. |
| `game.research.info` | `def` | `RimResearchInfo` | One project. |
| `game.research.current` |  | `RimResearchInfo?` | The project being researched. |
| `game.research.set_current` | `def` | `boolean` | Starts researching a project. |
| `game.research.finish` | `def` | `boolean` | Completes a project at once, with the game's letter. |
| `game.research.set_progress` | `def, progress` | `number` | Sets the progress of a project, clamped to its cost. |
| `game.research.knowledge` | `category, add?` | `RimKnowledge` | Anomaly knowledge. Adds points to a category (Basic or Advanced) when asked. |
| `game.stats.value` | `thing, stat` | `number?` | The final value of a stat for a thing, nil when the stat is disabled for it. |
| `game.stats.explain` | `thing, stat` | `RimStatExplanation` | The value with the game's own explanation of where it comes from. |
| `game.stats.defs` | `category?` | `RimStatDef[]` | Every stat def, optionally one category. |
